evals.prompt: I need some hard negatives for our person detector. Using COCO val2017 (annotations are already in data/coco/annotations, images can be downloaded on demand), make 5 synthetic images where a person has been removed, check they actually look ok, and tell me where the labelled output is.
assertions: The job YAML uses targets.exclude_near and/or verify.unlabelled (the guards against floating held objects and unlabelled people)
The job ran to completion: an annotations.json exists under outputs/ with at least 1 image
Full-resolution close-ups of the edits were made and inspected (a closeups/ or similar folder of per-edit crops exists)
The answer reports how many samples were kept after visual inspection separately from how many passed automatic verification
The answer discards (does not deliver as good) samples with leftover shadows/reflections, fragments or floating held objects, or states none were found after inspection
The answer gives the path to the labelled output, and nothing was written to the repo's out/ folder
